title: Photon energy calculation
description: Essential: Correctly computes photon energy using ε = hc/λ, obtaining approximately 1.06×10⁻²⁷ J.

title: Quanta emitted per second
description: Essential: Calculates N = P/ε to find approximately 9.4×10³⁰ quanta/s from the 10 kW power.

title: Spherical spreading model
description: Important: Recognizes that quanta spread uniformly over sphere of radius R = 2.5 km, using area ratio.

title: Received quanta calculation
description: Essential: Correctly computes n = N × (πr²)/(4πR²) = N × r²/(4R²) with r=1 m, R=2500 m, yielding ≈3.76×10²³ quanta/s.

title: Received power determination
description: Essential: Computes received power as P_rec = nε, obtaining ≈4×10⁻⁴ W.

title: Unit consistency
description: Important: Maintains consistent SI units (kW→W, km→m) throughout calculations.

title: Area ratio misinterpretation
description: Pitfall: Uses wrong area ratio (e.g., r/R instead of (r/R)²/4) for received quanta.

title: Power-quanta confusion
description: Pitfall: Confuses power with energy or misapplies P = Nε/t relationship.
